publication_policy: All observed headline metrics use the same reference year. A missing value is never replaced with zero or another year.

co2.label: Global Carbon Budget · national fossil CO₂ emissions, via OWID Grapher
co2.definition: Territorial fossil and industrial CO₂ emissions; land-use change and other greenhouse gases are excluded.

population.label: World Bank · World Development Indicators
population.definition: Total population for the same reference year, used only as the denominator of CO₂ per capita.

gdp.label: World Bank · GDP, PPP (constant 2021 international $)
gdp.definition: GDP in purchasing-power-parity terms at constant 2021 international dollars.

electricity.label: Eurostat · monthly net electricity generation, annualised from 12 complete months
electricity.definition: Share of electricity generation. It is not the share of renewables in total final energy consumption.

warming.label: Copernicus Climate Change Service · ERA5 monthly averaged reanalysis
warming.definition: Annual mean 2 m air-temperature anomaly relative to the 1991–2020 national mean.

hot_days.label: Copernicus Climate Change Service · ERA5-Land daily statistics
hot_days.definition: Area-weighted mean annual count of grid-cell days whose daily maximum 2 m temperature is at least 30 °C.

fire.label: JRC Global Wildfire Information System · MCD64A1 burned area
fire.definition: Satellite-derived annual burned area in hectares, using one MCD64A1 method for every country. It may include intentional vegetation-management fires.

hot_days_ge_30_c.method: area-weighted national mean of grid-cell counts
